mentions.name: Kitted
mentions.description: This local desktop app manages inventory and production for small businesses and makers, featuring bill of materials, purchase and production orders, "can I make n?" availability checks, stock takes, multiple stock locations, and barcode scanning. Multiple users can connect to it over the local network.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a local desktop app for inventory and production management: https://kitted.site

It includes bill of materials, purchase/production orders, "can I make n?", stock takes, multiple stock locations, and barcode scanning. It's aimed mainly at small business and makers for the time-being, but still allows multiple users to connect over the the local network.
